017package org.apache.juneau.rest.server.mcp;
018
019import static org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.AssertionUtils.*;
020
021import java.lang.reflect.*;
022import java.util.*;
023import java.util.function.*;
024
025import org.apache.juneau.bean.jsonrpc.*;
026import org.apache.juneau.commons.inject.*;
027import org.apache.juneau.commons.utils.*;
028import org.apache.juneau.marshall.*;
029import org.apache.juneau.marshall.json.*;
030import org.apache.juneau.marshall.jsonschema.*;
031import org.apache.juneau.marshall.marshaller.Json;
032
033/**
034 * Bridges {@link McpTypedToolHandler typed tool handlers} into raw {@link McpToolHandler}s.
035 *
036 * <p>
037 * The single public entry point is {@link #adaptTool(McpTypedToolHandler)}, which:
038 * <ul>
039 *    <li>Derives the input and output JSON Schemas once (at adaptation time) from the typed handler's declared
040 *       {@link McpTypedToolHandler#argumentType() argument} and {@link McpTypedToolHandler#resultType() result}
041 *       types, caching them in a single {@link McpToolSpec descriptor} instance returned on every
042 *       {@link McpToolHandler#descriptor()} call.
043 *    <li>Binds incoming JSON arguments into an instance of the argument type, mapping binding failures to
044 *       JSON-RPC {@code -32602} (invalid params).
045 *    <li>Invokes the typed handler and canonicalizes the returned value into a generic JSON tree in a single
046 *       serialization pass, mapping canonicalization and structural-safety failures to JSON-RPC {@code -32603}
047 *       (internal error).
048 *    <li>Optionally mirrors the canonical structured content as a single text content block.
049 * </ul>
050 */
051public final class McpTypedHandlers {
052
053   private static final JsonSerializer CANONICAL =
054      JsonSerializer.create().addBeanTypes(false).uriResolution(UriResolution.NONE).build();
055
056   private static final JsonSchemaGenerator SCHEMA_GENERATOR =
057      JsonSchemaGenerator.create().useBeanDefs().build();
058
059   private McpTypedHandlers() {}
060
061   /**
062    * Adapts a typed tool handler into a raw {@link McpToolHandler}.
063    *
064    * @param <A> The tool argument type.
065    * @param <R> The tool result type.
066    * @param typed The typed handler to adapt. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
067    * @return A raw handler that derives schemas, binds arguments, and canonicalizes results. Never <jk>null</jk>.
068    */
069   public static <A,R> McpToolHandler adaptTool(McpTypedToolHandler<A,R> typed) {
070      assertArgNotNull("typed", typed);
071      var declared = assertArgNotNull("typed.descriptor()", typed.descriptor());
072      var descriptor = new McpToolSpec()
073         .setName(declared.getName())
074         .setDescription(declared.getDescription())
075         .setInputSchema(schema(typed.argumentType()))
076         .setOutputSchema(schema(typed.resultType()));
077      return new McpToolHandler() {
078         @Override public McpToolSpec descriptor() {
079            return descriptor;
080         }
081
082         @Override public McpToolOutcome call(Map<String,Object> arguments, BeanStore ctx) {
083            var bound = McpTypedHandlers.<A>bind(arguments, typed.argumentType());
084            var result = typed.call(bound, ctx);
085            var tree = canonicalize(result);
086            try {
087               JsonValueSafety.check(tree, "Tool structuredContent");
088            } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
089               throw new McpException(-32603, e.getMessage());
090            }
091            var outcome = new McpToolOutcome().setStructuredContent(tree);
092            if (typed.mirrorStructuredContentAsText())
093               outcome.setContent(List.of(McpContentBlock.text(render(tree))));
094            return outcome;
095         }
096      };
097   }
098
099   /**
100    * Builds a typed tool from a name, description, argument/result types, and a {@code call} lambda, then adapts
101    * it into a raw {@link McpToolHandler} via {@link #adaptTool(McpTypedToolHandler)}.
102    *
103    * <p>
104    * The sanctioned one-expression path for the common case: declaring a typed tool no longer requires a named
105    * class implementing {@link McpTypedToolHandler}. Schema derivation, argument binding, and result
106    * canonicalization are exactly what {@link #adaptTool(McpTypedToolHandler)} already does.
107    *
108    * @param <A> The tool argument type.
109    * @param <R> The tool result type.
110    * @param name The tool name. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
111    * @param description The human-readable tool description. Can be <jk>null</jk>.
112    * @param argumentType The tool argument class, used for both schema derivation and argument binding. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
113    * @param resultType The tool result class, used for schema derivation. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
114    * @param call The call body, invoked with the bound argument and the per-request bean store. Must not be <jk>null</jk>.
115    * @return A raw handler that derives schemas, binds arguments, and canonicalizes results. Never <jk>null</jk>.
116    */
117   public static <A,R> McpToolHandler tool(String name, String description, Class<A> argumentType, Class<R> resultType, BiFunction<A,BeanStore,R> call) {
118      assertArgNotNull("name", name);
119      assertArgNotNull("argumentType", argumentType);
120      assertArgNotNull("resultType", resultType);
121      assertArgNotNull("call", call);
122      return adaptTool(new McpTypedToolHandler<A,R>() {
123         @Override public McpToolSpec descriptor() {
124            return new McpToolSpec().setName(name).setDescription(description);
125         }
126
127         @Override public Type argumentType() {
128            return argumentType;
129         }
130
131         @Override public Type resultType() {
132            return resultType;
133         }
134
135         @Override public R call(A arguments, BeanStore ctx) {
136            return call.apply(arguments, ctx);
137         }
138      });
139   }
140
141   /**
142    * Derives a revision-neutral schema carrier from a Java type.
143    *
144    * <p>
145    * Uses a generator with bean definitions enabled, so nested bean types are emitted under {@code $defs} and
146    * referenced rather than inlined.
147    *
148    * @param type The type to derive a schema for.
149    * @return The derived schema, or <jk>null</jk> if the generator produced no schema.
150    */
151   private static McpSchema schema(Type type) {
152      try {
153         var session = SCHEMA_GENERATOR.getSession();
154         var raw = session.getSchema(type);
155         if (raw != null && session.getBeanDefs() != null && ! session.getBeanDefs().isEmpty())
156            raw.append("$defs", session.getBeanDefs());
157         return raw == null ? null : McpSchema.of(raw);
158      } catch (Exception e) {
159         throw new McpException(-32603, "Failed to derive tool schema for " + type.getTypeName() + ": " + e.getMessage());
160      }
161   }
162
163   @SuppressWarnings({
164      "unchecked" // Parser returns the value described by the authoritative runtime Type.
165   })
166   private static <A> A bind(Map<String,Object> arguments, Type type) {
167      try {
168         return (A)JsonParser.DEFAULT.read(Json.of(arguments), type);
169      } catch (Exception e) {
170         throw new McpException(-32602, "Failed to bind tool arguments to " + type.getTypeName() + ": " + e.getMessage());
171      }
172   }
173
174   private static Object canonicalize(Object result) {
175      try {
176         var json = CANONICAL.write(result);
177         return JsonParser.DEFAULT.read(json, Object.class);
178      } catch (Exception e) {
179         throw new McpException(-32603, "Failed to canonicalize tool result: " + e.getMessage());
180      }
181   }
182
183   private static String render(Object tree) {
184      try {
185         return CANONICAL.write(tree);
186      } catch (Exception e) {
187         throw new McpException(-32603, "Failed to mirror tool structuredContent: " + e.getMessage());
188      }
189   }
190}
